completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:ADV-0002 emitted ONLY when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, records BOTH named probes verbatim with their raw output, carries exactly one verdict from {CONFIRMED|REFUTED|PARTIAL|NOT-CHECKED|BLOCKED} per enumerated target, and records the result of every listed control/negative test. Any missing control downgrades the unit's verdicts to NOT-CHECKED. Otherwise FAILED:ADV-0002 <reason>.
evidence_requirement: Probe 1: import each call site's reducer and run the 200-outcome corpus through all of them, emitting a verdict matrix. Probe 2 (mechanically different): static call-graph extraction proving each site actually reaches the shared symbol rather than a local copy - a site that agrees on all 200 but does not call the shared symbol is a latent fork and must be reported.
inputs: every call site that computes completion, located by grep for the predicate symbol rather than by reading the design doc
a frozen corpus of 200 real unit outcomes spanning PASS, partial, sentinel-missing, schema-invalid and timeout
_USER-PROMPTS.md:11314 (known failure class: two completion predicates disagree)
mechanism: cross-implementation differential over a frozen outcome corpus plus a call-graph reachability control
not_a_duplicate_because: ADV-0001 asks whether the predicate is right; this asks whether there is only ONE of it. Different failure, different artifact.
question_or_target: Do the reducer implementations embedded in the local runner, cloud dispatcher, monitor, harvester, workflow fan-in, cross-vendor adapter and final synthesis return byte-identical verdicts for the same 200 recorded unit outcomes, or has the 'one shared predicate' rule already forked?
retry_policy: two strikes then pivot (AGENTS.md 4b): after the SECOND failure on the same hypothesis, enumerate >=2 mechanically different attack vectors before any third attempt; consecutive FAILED on the same error fingerprint is the trigger
reviewer_requirement: one cross-vendor Anthropic (opus) refuter who re-derives the counterexample from the raw artifact and NOT from this unit's report; a same-vendor reviewer shares this unit's blind spots and does not satisfy the requirement
tests_required: mutate the shared reducer to invert condition 7 and require EVERY site's verdict to change; a site whose verdict is unchanged is running its own copy
title: Differential run of every completion-predicate implementation over one shared outcome corpus
